title: The plain bag, ii
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Tuesday. The sample bag arrives: BARNABY'S CHOICE, the pup's face on it, drawn by someone who has never seen a three-legged dog. Four legs. The strip counts them.

panels.composition: The garage. A shipping box open. WOOD lifting out a bag of dog food. BARNABY II interested in the bag, not the face on it.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man lifting a printed bag of dog food out of a shipping box in a garage while a small three-legged dog sniffs at it

panels.composition: The bag: a cartoon dog's face and body, cheerful, BARNABY'S CHOICE in a rounded font. Four legs. Wood's finger counting: one, two, three, four.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of a dog-food bag printed with a cheerful cartoon dog that has four legs and a man's finger counting them
image.notes: Letter after: BARNABY'S CHOICE in a rounded commercial font unlike the strip's. Four legs: the point.

panels.composition: Wood holding the bag beside the actual dog. The actual dog: three. The bag: four. The dog looking at the bag's dog with no recognition at all.

characters.pose: holding the bag beside the dog

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man holding a dog-food bag with a four-legged cartoon dog beside a real three-legged dog who shows no recognition, no words

balloons.text: They gave you the leg back.
...That's the whole problem, isn't it. They'd give you the leg back.
